title: DISPOSITION v1 dispose request
description: internal/server/disposition.DisposeRequest (RFC 0001 section 8.2: dispose(item_id | group_id, verdict, edited_payload?, note?, idempotency_key)). Exactly one of item_id/group_id is required at the protocol-semantics level (enforced by the handler, not expressible as a flat json-schema required list here); idempotency_key is required at this wire layer even though the underlying store treats an empty key as no idempotency check.

edited_payload.description: Opaque JSON payload for an edit_accept verdict -- not constrained here.

note.description: Required by the store when verdict is reject.
